annotation.bound_parties_text: The Directive makes economic operators (manufacturers, software/AI system providers treated as manufacturers, importers, authorised representatives, fulfilment service providers, distributors and online platforms) liable for defective products, and requires Member States to transpose it.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A developer or producer of software, including AI system providers within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council, should be treated as a manufacturer.
annotation.dates_quote: DIRECTIVE (EU) 2024/2853 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 23 October 2024 on liability for defective products and repealing Council Directive 85/374/EEC
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Software, such as operating systems, firmware, computer programs, applications or AI systems, is increasingly common on the market and plays an increasingly important role for product safety.
